rationale: The workflow already implements the two applicable optimizations. Dependency caching is present via `actions/setup-node@v4` with `cache: npm` around `npm ci`, satisfying P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency-download state cached, installation and all required tests kept); the contraindication "an equivalent cache already exists" applies, so no change is warranted. Cancel superseded/in-progress runs is present via `concurrency: group: ${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true`, satisfying P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (partitioned by ref/branch-PR, distinct branches isolated, no release or deployment work). The remaining candidate, P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, cannot be safely applied: the repository has no completed CI runs and no representative successful-duration history (ci_history status: no_completed_runs), so a safe timeout value cannot be derived and an arbitrary short limit risks the contraindication that valid slow runs (npm ci plus build, lint, format-check, and test) exceed it. All other patterns are inapplicable: no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no schedule (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), a single required job with a strict full-check contract (P-LIT-SELECT, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT, P-LIT-PRIORITIZE), no Bazel (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), and no trusted distributed-cache infrastructure (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE). Build and test coverage is preserved, so no change is made.
